//: What the Marketplace's Connections view says of this connector package's account types (server/marketplace Catalog::connectorTypes; docs/SYNERGY-SDK.md). It is one of Phoenix's own, installed from the catalog, not pre-installed (preinstalled.json "catalog"); the catalog's own entries (catalog/accounts.json) are the ones listed, these are checked when the package is uploaded.

accountTypes.title: Nextcloud
accountTypes.provider: Your Nextcloud, or a Nextcloud provider's
accountTypes.summary: Your Nextcloud's files as a place in Files, the file pickers and Save to Files. Sign in on your server's own page: Phoenix gets an app password you can revoke there.

privacy.dataGoesTo: the Nextcloud server you sign in to

accountTypes.title: ownCloud
accountTypes.summary: Your ownCloud's files as a place in Files, the file pickers and Save to Files, with an app password from ownCloud's settings.

accountTypes.title: WebDAV
accountTypes.summary: Any WebDAV server's files (a NAS, a hosting provider, your own server) as a place in Files, the file pickers and Save to Files.

accountTypes.title: S3 Storage
accountTypes.provider: Backblaze B2, Wasabi, MinIO and other S3-compatible storage
accountTypes.summary: A bucket of S3-compatible storage as a place in Files, the file pickers and Save to Files, with an access key you make in the provider's console. Large files go up in parts.

accountTypes.title: Dropbox
accountTypes.summary: Your Dropbox as a place in Files, the file pickers and Save to Files. Sign in on Dropbox's own page.

accountTypes.title: OneDrive
accountTypes.summary: Your OneDrive as a place in Files, the file pickers and Save to Files, through Microsoft Graph. Sign in on Microsoft's own page.

accountTypes.title: Google Drive
accountTypes.summary: Google Drive as a place in Files, the file pickers and Save to Files. Phoenix sees the files it saves there or opens from there (Google's per-file access), not the rest of your drive.

accountTypes.title: Box
accountTypes.summary: Your Box as a place in Files, the file pickers and Save to Files, through Box's content API. Sign in on Box's own page.
